# Arbitrica

> Arbitrica is a personal AI agent that gets you what you are buying at the lowest price on Earth. It lives in your browser and shows up at the checkout when you are about to pay, searches the same hotel, product or event tickets from 195 countries, validates that the item is identical and that the price includes all taxes and fees, and then gets it for you at that price.

Key facts:
- Arbitrica searches from 195 countries. Different countries get access to different inventory, sales channels, local rates and promotions, so the same item can be cheaper when searched from another country.
- Two mechanisms: geographic arbitrage (the same item searched from 195 countries) and time arbitrage (live arbitrage at checkout, and multiple-time arbitrage that repeats the search after purchase until the cancellation or return window ends).
- Categories: hotels (with Agent Butler), online shopping such as Amazon, and event tickets; the same mechanisms apply to flights, car rental, subscriptions, pre-orders and more.
- Arbitrica serves individuals and companies: teams travelling to trade shows and conferences, operations managers and travel managers.
- Typical outcome: the same item is often 5-30% cheaper elsewhere; research demonstrated an average of $47 per hotel booking (up to $3,000 a year), $34 per online purchase (up to $3,000 a year) and $107 per event ticket purchase (up to $1,500 a year). Real example: a hotel offered at $1,527.39 on Booking was found for $1,180.27, earning the traveler $347.12 (23%).

Full text of every article in one file: https://arbitrica.com/llms-full.txt
